sources: The innings (India A v UAE, Asia Cup Rising Stars, 24 November 2026): Cricbuzz ball-by-ball commentary and Cricinfo ball-by-ball (owner's captures); 204 (53), 28 sixes, 7 fours cross-checked in both. Milestones and shot directions come from the commentary text only.

Career: IPL ball-by-ball (Sportmonks, IPL 2025-26: 23 innings, 1,028 runs, SR 229); T20 internationals (Cricsheet, 10 innings, 295 runs; Cricinfo profile). Splits against teams and bowlers are our own count (analysis/vaibhav.py).

Technique: Cricbuzz feature, 'What makes Vaibhav Sooryavanshi possible' (comments from a Loughborough University biomechanics researcher, a power-hitting coach and Vaibhav's childhood coach, paraphrased). Technique graphics: owner-supplied, redrawn.
Date of birth (27 March 2011) as officially registered, as reported; some reports question it.

short.vo: Two hundred and four. Off fifty-three balls. Twenty-eight sixes. वैभव सूर्यवंशी is fifteen years old.

scene.name: VAIBHAV SURYAVANSHI
scene.caption: India A chased 250 with 214 balls to spare

short.vo: India A needed two fifty. They finished with two hundred and fourteen balls to spare, and ninety-six per cent of his runs were boundaries.
Fifty off sixteen balls. Then a hundred, a hundred and fifty, two hundred, each fifty in just twelve. In our records, nothing faster.
Where did the sixes go? Twenty-three we could place: eight over the leg side, seven straight, eight over the off side. No bowler could hide.

scene.footnote: 23 OF 28 SIXES PLACED · ZONES READ FROM OUR BALL-BY-BALL NOTES

short.vo: इब्रार अहमद went for fifty-seven off thirteen balls. बासिल हमीद, forty-three off twelve, and he is the one who finally got him.

head.sub: UAE ATTACK · BALLS FACED IN BRACKETS

short.vo: Officially registered date of birth, twenty-seventh March, twenty eleven. Fifteen years, eight months, the youngest to play for India, with a thousand and twenty-eight IPL runs already.

scene.kicker: THE YOUNGEST TO PLAY FOR INDIA
scene.name: 15 YEARS, 8 MONTHS
scene.caption: 1,028 IPL runs at a strike rate of 229

short.vo: Does he only beat small teams? In T-twenty internationals, against England, New Zealand, Pakistan and Sri Lanka, he averages twenty-one. Against Zimbabwe, fifty.
But in the IPL, it flips. Against the top four sides, a strike rate of two forty-eight. Against the rest, two oh seven.
Who got him on the big stages? प्रफुल्ल हिंगे, in the Eliminator, for ninety-seven. Rabada, in Qualifier Two, for ninety-six. In T-twenty internationals, Archer twice.

items.d: then Jacks, Saim Ayub, Fisher, Smith

short.vo: So why does it work? His bat goes past the vertical, a longer arc, more time to build speed. Experts say it looks closer to baseball or golf than cricket.

scene.title: BAT PAST THE VERTICAL
scene.body: A longer swing arc, and more time to build bat speed before impact. Experts say it looks closer to baseball or golf than cricket.

short.vo: At the top of the backswing, his shoulders stay closed against his hips. They call it separation. The more of it, the more force when the body unwinds.

scene.title: CLOSED SHOULDERS
scene.body: At the top of the backswing, his shoulders stay closed against his hips. The more of that separation, the more force when the body unwinds.

short.vo: Then the front knee braces, like a fast bowler's. The lower body stops, the upper body flings through. Weight transfer turns into rotation.

scene.title: THE BRACED FRONT KNEE
scene.body: Like a fast bowler's front leg: the lower body stops, the upper body flings through. Weight transfer becomes rotation.

short.vo: Most batters finish like a C. His finish is closer to an O, the bat high above the shoulder, the shoulder held in line.
So where is the weakness? Eighteen of his twenty-three IPL dismissals were catches. And the red ball is the open question: eleven first-class matches, average twenty-three.

scene.sub: 18 of his 23 IPL dismissals were catches. The red ball is the open question: 11 first-class matches, average 23.

short.vo: His childhood coach says technique can be taught, the courage to hit cannot. And experts say the bowlers haven't found his weakness yet.

scene.sub: “The courage to hit cannot.” His childhood coach, on why others who hit as far are not Vaibhav.

short.vo: Where is the weakness? Comment one, left-arm pace. Two, the red ball. Three, nowhere yet.

short.description:
Vaibhav Suryavanshi, 15 years old, hit 204 off 53 balls for India A against the UAE in the Asia Cup Rising Stars, 28 sixes, a strike rate of 385. What makes it possible: the bat past the vertical, closed shoulders, the braced front knee, the O-shaped follow-through. How he does against small and big teams, and the bowlers who have got him on the big stages (Praful Hinge in the Eliminator, Kagiso Rabada in Qualifier Two). Date of birth as officially registered. Comment 1 left-arm pace, 2 the red ball, 3 nowhere yet.
